Extract the reusable scene/runtime into PortfolioSaver.Presentation.
Extract the reusable settings experience into PortfolioSaver.Settings.

validated_flows: queued remote desktop UX cycle with command acknowledgement and live summary updates
ssh_first_vm_harness.interactive_launch_method: Push-VmWorkspace.ps1 stages the repo and publish bundle, Guest-ConfigureDesktopAutomation.ps1 prepares the desktop account, the host starts PortfolioSaver.VmAgent.exe in session 1 with PsExec, waits for agent-status.json, then queues a UX command JSON under commands\ that the agent executes inside the interactive desktop session while supervising WinAppDriver and invoking fullscreen through the ViewFullScreenMenuItem automation hook.
harness_policy_notes: The current SSH/SFTP plus PortfolioSaver.VmAgent desktop-session harness is the canonical supported workflow.
Do not re-optimize or re-architect the working harness glue during normal feature work.
Change the harness only when the current path is broken or a concrete new validation requirement cannot be met with the existing flow.

current_operational_recommendations: Use the SSH/SFTP remote harness for normal Windows target build, publish, and UX validation work.
Treat PortfolioSaver.Desktop as the primary runtime target for Beta 5.5 work.
Retain the legacy screensaver host only while compatibility still matters.
Use the safe-temp build/publish scripts for repeatable validation rather than ad-hoc repo-path publish commands.
Treat the remote target as a generic Windows machine so the same harness can move from a VM to a physical PC without orchestration changes.
Let PortfolioSaver.VmAgent own interactive-session automation instead of attempting to launch UX runs directly through SSH-driven PowerShell.
Use build/vm/test-secrets.json for remote live validation secrets instead of persisting any API keys into plaintext settings.json.
Treat the current agent-based remote harness glue as locked unless it breaks or a new validation requirement forces a targeted change.

current_priority_backlog.title: Brent crude macro symbol BZ=F remains unresolved during soak runs
notes: MacroSnapshot repeatedly reports missing_symbols=[BZ=F] while CRUDE shows a fallback-looking static value.
QuoteResolutionSummary repeatedly reports stale_symbols=[BZ=F] and macro_missing_symbols=[BZ=F].
Resolved on 2026-05-12 by routing Brent to the Stooq global-market provider using cb.f instead of treating BZ=F as a dedicated Yahoo-only warmup symbol.

current_priority_backlog.title: Yahoo warmup for Brent crude is rate-limited with HTTP 429 at startup
notes: The startup Yahoo spark warmup for [BZ=F] fails with Too Many Requests and is deferred to later scheduled refreshes.
This appears to be the leading cause of TRC-001.
Resolved on 2026-05-12 by removing Brent from the dedicated Yahoo warmup lane, eliminating the startup 429 dependency for BZ=F.
Fresh VM proof ux-deep-ssh-20260512-074109 no longer shows startup Yahoo rate-limit failures for Brent.

current_priority_backlog.title: Graph cards never materialize during the latest one-hour soak
notes: ApplySceneStateComplete continues to report graph_count=0 throughout the soak.
WarmGraphsAsync repeatedly starts and is then cancelled without producing visible graph cards.
Resolved on 2026-05-12 by preserving an in-flight graph warmup across refresh ticks instead of cancelling it on each preserveLayout refresh.
Fresh VM proof ux-deep-ssh-20260512-081832 shows WarmGraphsAsync yielded SIZE, ApplyOrUpdateGraph count=1, and sustained ApplySceneStateComplete graph_count=1 for the remainder of the run.

current_priority_backlog.title: Scene stays in Live+Cache (Partial) because Brent never resolves
notes: The runtime continues to operate, but the provider label remains partial because the Brent macro symbol never leaves the stale/missing set.
This is a downstream product-quality symptom of TRC-001 and TRC-002.
Resolved on 2026-05-12 as a downstream effect of the Brent reroute; QuoteResolutionSummary in ux-deep-ssh-20260512-074109 reaches remaining_symbol_count=0 and macro_missing_symbols=[].
The scene no longer remains stuck in a Brent-driven partial state during the validated 20-minute proof.

current_priority_backlog.title: Displayed-vs-reference comparison capture yields empty comparison arrays
notes: The original guest-side extractor produced empty comparison arrays because it tried to read the live circular trace as a normal append-only tail during the run.

Resolved on 2026-05-12 by adding host-side PostProcess-ReferenceSpotChecks.ps1, which reconstructs the pulled circular trace using trace.circular.log plus trace.circular.idx and writes non-empty DisplayedVsReferenceFeed comparisons after Pull-VmResults completes.
Guest-UxDeepExercise now treats guest-side reference spot checks as best-effort so a failed live trace read no longer fails the desktop phase.
The diagnostic is now actionable because comparison arrays are populated from real pulled VM traces rather than left empty.

current_priority_backlog.title: Douglas Adams / William Shakespeare closing quote repeats distractingly in the news ticker
notes: Resolved on 2026-05-12 by separating the DeepSeek summary paragraph from the closing quotation and marking the quotation as a supplemental headline that is shown once per expanded sequence instead of being multiplied during headline expansion.
FinanceNewsService now returns the quote as a separate prefixed item, BuildNews styles and preserves that supplemental item, and ExpandHeadlineItems duplicates only normal headline items.
Validated by focused unit coverage plus a fresh green VM proof in build/vm/artifacts/ssh-runs/ux-deep-ssh-20260512-132159.
